summary_1line: A philosophical discourse explains the soul’s independence from senses, its transmigration, and how knowledge and understanding reveal the subtle Self beyond bodily elements.
themes: three gunas and states of consciousness

image_candidates.scene_text: A yogi sits in meditation while the five senses appear as lamps on tall trees illuminating different objects around him.
After death, a subtle figure rises from a fallen body and dissolves into space, wind, fire, water, and earth swirling around it.
A wise seeker rubs two sticks together to kindle fire, symbolizing the revelation of the hidden Supreme Soul within.
